drafted_from: the old server's publishTool/unpublishTool at b6ae0ebf815f (src/workshop.mjs:1686, 1793), ported as tool:publish-tool
start_here: Say to your AI: "Publish my tool tool:echo-test as my listing."
no_lists_because: A listing is one row of the marketplace_listings table in the database the person names (the tool makes that table on first use), not a row of a list, so there is no list for a person to keep or pour into.
instructions: 1. Save the tool first with tool:save-tool, in the database the listing goes to.
2. Say to your AI which saved tool to publish, the maker's name, and the database, and whether it shows on the public site (default no).
3. Read the answer: the listing with its status published. A refusal names the problem in plain words; fix it and publish again.

worked_examples.title: Publish a saved tool
worked_examples.ask: Save this tool so I can find it later: it echoes text back.

input.database: the database the listing is in

worked_examples.given: Publish or withdraw tool:echo-test for this maker
worked_examples.hands_back: The listing: tool_id "tool:echo-test", status "published", show_on_public_site false.
